crew.overview: The extraordinary tale of Harriet Tubman's escape from slavery and transformation into one of America's greatest heroes. Her courage, ingenuity and tenacity freed hundreds of slaves and changed the course of history.
crew.title: Harriet

details.biography: Pen Densham is a film and television producer, writer, and director born in England. At nineteen, he moved to Canada and became a Canadian citizen. He co-founded the Toronto-based production company Insight Productions with John Watson. The duo also founded  the Trilogy Entertainment Group in Hollywood and its Canadian counterpart, Trilogy Entertainment North. Densham married and has two children with Wendy Savage.
details.name: Pen Densham
